Third-party files in assets1/vendor/ as the site serves them.

Version: from the file's own header. Files marked * have no header; their version is the release the
core pages loaded from a CDN before the files were copied here (commit c4cb9f3, and e63b2a5 for
jarallax.min.css). The sourceMappingURL comment was removed from the Bootstrap JS and CSS and the
jarallax JS, since their .map files are not shipped.

SHA-256: of the file in this folder. When a file changes, update its line
(sha256sum <file>, or Get-FileHash <file> in PowerShell).
